planned_before_analysis: 2026-10-30; evaluates data availability and physical quality only, not classifier scores
session_definition: Original PCAP capture; profile streams within the same PCAP are not independent sessions
class_source: Previously accepted author-documented candidate roles; original labels unchanged
recommended_ml_quality: Full capture-ordered non-overlapping windows; complete and consistent configuration/radio/frame fields; accepted single candidate role; temporal gaps and TSF resets do not disqualify non-temporal features. Use only configuration+radio+frame features on such windows.
recommended_time_shield_quality: Retain original fixed-window 1.5 gap criterion, incoming-boundary check and TSF reset rejection. No slope across TSF reset.
selection_rule: Recommendations are based on which feature groups remain valid under capture artifacts. No final-test classifier scores are used. Gap-threshold relaxations are descriptive only.
